The '''Rii Jenks Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and dining establishment that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The cantina was situated close to the rundown [[Formos Spaceport]] and it attracted a diverse, cosmopolitan range of customers. The establishment was run by the aged [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Rii Jenks]] and Jenks paid regular bribes to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] and local [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] to dissuade them from interring with his business, while he also evaded the ire of local [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] groups by permitting them to make use of the cantina's facilities.
